# Getting help

Most answers are already written down:

- **Your connection broke:** Settings > Turn off protection, or run `CS2IPChanger.exe --restore` if the window won't open. More in [If something goes wrong](https://github.com/Sepd0x/cs2-ip-changer#if-something-goes-wrong).
- **The phone isn't found or tethering won't start:** press Phone setup under Phone. It checks the cable, the USB driver, USB debugging, tethering and the phone's Wi-Fi, and tells you the one step left.
- **Questions about VPNs, VAC, ping, CGNAT, hotspots or regions:** see the [FAQ](https://github.com/Sepd0x/cs2-ip-changer#faq).
- **Something is wrong in the app:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/Sepd0x/cs2-ip-changer/issues/new/choose) with the version and Log > Save bug report. Look through the .zip before you post it.
- **A way your home IP could leak:** report it privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
